sentences.text: Cuando Juan llegó a casa, vio que el libro que había dejado sobre la mesa ya no estaba allí.
sentences.english: When Juan got home, he saw that the book he had left on the table was no longer there.

sentences.text: Buscó en la cocina, en la sala y debajo de la cama, pero no lo encontró.
sentences.english: He looked in the kitchen, in the living room and under the bed, but he did not find it.

sentences.text: —Qué raro, estoy seguro de que lo dejé aquí —pensó.
sentences.english: "How strange, I am sure I left it here," he thought.

sentences.text: Juan se sentó e intentó recordar lo que había hecho esa mañana.
sentences.english: Juan sat down and tried to remember what he had done that morning.

sentences.text: Se había levantado temprano, había tomado café y había leído unas páginas.
sentences.english: He had got up early, had had coffee and had read a few pages.
Then he had gone out to work.

sentences.text: Entonces recordó que su hermana Sofía había pasado por la casa a la hora del almuerzo.
sentences.english: Then he remembered that his sister Sofía had dropped by the house at lunchtime.
Juan called her on the phone.
"Sofía, have you seen my book?" he asked.

sentences.text: —Sí, lo tengo yo, porque quería leerlo esta noche —dijo ella.
sentences.english: "Yes, I have it, because I wanted to read it tonight," she said.

sentences.text: —No hay problema —dijo Juan—, pero la próxima vez dime antes de que te lo lleves.
sentences.english: "No problem," said Juan, "but next time tell me before you take it."
"You are right, I am sorry," said Sofía.

sentences.text: —No te preocupes, quédatelo y léelo con calma.
sentences.english: "Don't worry, keep it and read it at your own pace."

sentences.text: —Gracias. Cuando lo termine, te lo traeré, aunque tarde unos días.
sentences.english: "Thanks. When I finish it, I will bring it to you, even if it takes a few days."

sentences.text: —Está bien. Quiero que lo disfrutes —dijo Juan.
sentences.english: "That's fine. I want you to enjoy it," said Juan.

sentences.text: Después de colgar, Juan miró la mesa vacía.
sentences.english: After hanging up, Juan looked at the empty table.

sentences.text: Sacó otro libro del estante y se puso a leer.
sentences.english: He took another book from the shelf and started to read.

sentences.text: Pensó que, al fin y al cabo, un libro prestado también se lee.
sentences.english: He thought that, after all, a borrowed book gets read too.
